label: matrix-v3
scope: Serial actual shared Lua core; each fresh process measures generation/warm generation/validated replay plus real PDF/SVG serialization. No concurrent benchmark children.

data.scope: One fresh runtime, no instruction profiling hooks. Lua memory snapshots distinguish transient allocations and full collection; these are not whole-process memory or exact per-phase peaks. Measurements stay outside recipe/instance/scene hashes.
